nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-committing to expansions without adequate defense, as the opponent may apply early pressure.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue developing your economy and technology while strengthening your ground army. Maintain a defensive posture to handle possible early pressure.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have a solid defensive position and your economy is stable, or if you detect a significant opponent threat.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move toward a more developed ground posture with heavier production and technology, as seen in N002.

nodes.title: Early Game Tech/Economy Development
nodes.transition_goal: Transition smoothly into the early-midgame with a stronger ground army and additional production.
nodes.trigger_summary: Early game (around 180 seconds) with both sides developing; opponent shows a ground posture with possible pressure, while you have a heavy economy and technology focus.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid neglecting scouting; the opponent's tech path could lead to unexpected units like Banshees or Medivacs.
nodes.decision_direction: Increase production and technology while continuing to strengthen your ground army. Maintain your expansion and keep an eye on defense.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have a solid army composition and are ready to take map control, or if you see a tech switch from the opponent.
nodes.next_state_summary: Progress to a late-midgame state with a more diverse army, including Sentries and Immortals, as in N003.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy Intelligence indicates a ground posture with Siege Tanks and Marines, heavy production and technology. Possible pressure is still a concern, so maintain defensive awareness.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and production, with a ground army including Zealots and Stalkers. Your technology is heavy, and you are looking to increase production further.
nodes.strategic_reason: With a heavy economy, you can afford to ramp up production and tech to gain an advantage in the midgame. Siege Tanks require careful positioning, so your army composition should include units that can break or bypass them.
nodes.title: Early-Midgame Ground Strengthening
nodes.transition_goal: Transition into the midgame with a robust ground army and the ability to adapt to the opponent's composition.
nodes.trigger_summary: Early-midgame (around 300-360 seconds) where both sides have expanded their economies and production; opponent shows a ground posture with Siege Tanks and Marines.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid being too passive; the opponent may be preparing a large push. Keep scouting to detect any tech switches.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue to strengthen your ground army and increase production. Maintain your economy and consider adding tech upgrades to counter the opponent's composition.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have a decisive army advantage or if the opponent shows signs of a tech switch to air.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move toward a midgame state with a similar composition but possibly more upgrades, as seen in N004.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy Intelligence shows a ground posture with a mix of units, including Siege Tanks and Hellions. They have heavy production and technology, and their defense is heavy, indicating a well-established position.
nodes.own_situation: You have a heavy economy and production, with a ground army including Zealots, Stalkers, Sentries, and Immortals. Your technology is heavy, and you have a solid defensive posture.
nodes.strategic_reason: With a diverse ground army, you can handle various threats. Immortals are strong against Siege Tanks, and Sentries provide utility. Increasing production ensures you can sustain a long fight.
nodes.title: Late-Midgame Ground Army Diversification
nodes.transition_goal: Transition into the late game with a powerful ground army and the ability to transition to air if needed.
nodes.trigger_summary: Late-midgame (around 600 seconds) with both sides having heavy economies and production; opponent shows a ground posture with Siege Tanks, Marines, Reapers, and Hellions.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid overextending without proper scouting; the opponent may have hidden tech like Medivacs or Ravens.
nodes.decision_direction: Maintain your ground army strength and increase production. Consider adding upgrades to improve your army's effectiveness.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have a clear strategic advantage or if the opponent shows a significant tech switch.
nodes.next_state_summary: This state is similar to N003 but with a slightly different timing; it may lead to a late-midgame state with more upgrades.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy Intelligence indicates a ground posture with Marines and Marauders, heavy production and technology. Their defense is moderate, and they may be preparing for a push.

nodes.strategic_reason: Marauders are strong against armored units, so you need a mix of units to counter them. Sentries can provide shields, and Immortals can deal with Marauders effectively.
nodes.title: Midgame Ground Army Consolidation
nodes.transition_goal: Transition into the late game with a well-rounded army and the ability to adapt to the opponent's composition.
